title: Capstone: RGB Color Packer
description:
Pack and unpack colours like a graphics engine does.
```
Enter R G B (0-255): 255 136 0
Packed:  0xFF8800  (16746496)
Binary:  00000000111111111000100000000000
Unpacked: R=255 G=136 B=0
Inverted: 0x0077FF
Grayscale value: 156
Brightened 20%: R=255 G=163 B=0
```
requirements: `std::uint32_t pack(std::uint8_t r, std::uint8_t g, std::uint8_t b)` using `<<` and `|`
